Solara SMP

A friendly survival server where every build rises with the sun. Build, explore and grow a world together.

Join us

About the server

Survival

Vanilla-style survival with a close community. Start from nothing and build something you're proud of.

Community

Friendly players, shared projects and regular events. Everyone is welcome to join in.

Fair play

Respect other players and their builds. Griefing and cheating are not allowed.
